events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment, musical or otherwise?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 55th Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album that gave us the timeless anthem for peace was released today in 1971. Still as powerful as ever.

events.title: Apple's first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple unveiled the original iPod, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket' and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple introduced the game-changing device that put a thousand songs in your pocket. How many did you own?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No'. Which Bond theme is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, the inimitable John Cleese turns 87 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. A truly groundbreaking record that pushed boundaries. What's your standout track?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away at 45 in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost a legend. Remembering Freddie Mercury, whose voice and showmanship remain unmatched. His legacy truly lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that showed their incredible growth and creativity. Still sounds fresh!

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon at the age of 40 in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since his untimely death. His message of peace and love continues to resonate globally. Forever missed, never forgotten.
